scope: Ordinary standalone Malaysian company domestic-income workpaper
changes: Require per-source verified additions, deductions, statutory charges and allowances for every saved income exactly once.
Reuse reviewed staged computation with personal relief fixed to zero for companies; preserve individual computation behavior.
Prior business losses offset business statutory income only. Current adjusted business losses follow aggregation; unused capital allowances are separate from business losses.
Saved deduction summary and eligible prior losses must agree with workpaper, and chargeable income must match the derived amount.
API rejects an inconsistent manual chargeable base without changing case revision/result; accepted calculation and source snapshots survive restart/report export.

source.official_form: YA2026 Form C sample PartA A1-A18
source.download_note: Initial requests GET returned500; normal urllib request with User-Agent returned a valid PDF. Original bytes/hash retained. Sample is not a submission-ready return.

validation.browser: 2 passed in28.7s; company and resident individual saved/reopened
validation.business_boundaries: Prior loss versus nonbusiness interest; current loss; unused capital allowance; inconsistent/missing/unverified/duplicate workpapers; source SHA and persistence

compatibility: New optional contract workpaper defaults to null for historical request replay; new company calculation requires it. Saved historical runs are not rewritten.
limits: Only established allowable amounts; donation/zakat caps, loss vintages and ownership eligibility require supporting evidence.
Foreign income, group relief, incentives, Labuan and special regimes remain separate outstanding workflows.
